sloka: न गन्तव्यम् वनम् देव्या सीतया शीलवर्जिते ।अनुष्ठास्यति रामस्य सीता प्रकृतमासनम् ॥२-३७-२३॥
transliteration: na gantavyam vanam devyā sītayā śīlavarjite ।anuṣṭhāsyati rāmasya sītā prakṛtamāsanam ॥2-37-23॥

translations.english: You are devoid of good conduct, O Kaikeyi Divine Sita need not go to the forest. Remaining here she should occupy the royal throne of Rama.
